**Megasloth Mushroom Soup** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A soup made from the mushroom that only grows on a Mega Sloth's back.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Megasloth Mushroom | | Megasloth Mushroom Soup (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after having picked up a Megasloth Mushroom for the first time.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is run in "Proletariat" mode.
